The `root>big` element has `font-size: 32px` and inherits the unitless `line-height: 2` from `root`. When a unitless line-height is inherited, it gets multiplied by the element's own font-size, giving `32px × 2 = 64px`. This matches the `getBoundingClientRect` data which shows `height=64`.

ANSWER: 64
